messages.content: Build a pizzeria site with home, menu, about and contact pages
Swarm mode: the foundation is done. Call delegateTasks now with 2-4 tasks that own the remaining pages and features; writes to worker paths are refused.

function.name: delegateTasks
function.description: Run 2-4 tasks in parallel, each by a worker that writes only its owned paths (files or folders under src/, disjoint between tasks). Shared files (package.json, src/App.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, configs) stay yours. Call it once, after writing the shared foundation. Returns each task's report: done, unfinished or failed, the files it wrote, and its NEEDS: requests. A task with role "sub-orchestrator" (at most 2) splits its own paths among up to 3 workers.

solo.description: Only for a genuinely tiny request, with tasks []: why you build it yourself. The swarm board shows it.
